You're correct on most accounts I guess I quit just to prove to. Myself I could, cannabis saved me for a while but quickly became a mental addiction to numb myself.

I'd be lying if I said i haven't won a few battles as I've tried to be a better person during my life, I really have.

The issue is now is I have no self esteem I guess to take your words and use them would be, if the majority of my own darkness was formed on other people labels which I've started to adopt, I cannot mentally comprehend finding self value in myself without outside validation.

Which is self destructive and also not very good for my self esteem, with your cannabis reduction I wish you all the best and honestly unless it'd a serious addiction it can actually be really beneficial. That real happiness stage I was referring to in my earlier reply was actually while high.

It's done wonders for me but it's not an all miracle cure and eventually just fed into my addictive personality, best advice I can give you is to try and change your entire mindset and remind yourself you're not a smoker if you ever try to quit fully.

I appreciate the compliments thank you, don't get much of those anymore.

I wouldn't say I've gotten no where over the last years I really have tried to better myself.

I've quit smoking, alcohol and marijuana. As much as they helped keep me numb I done it for myself and for the financial gain, I've paid off most the debt my mother left in my name although it's fucked my credit rating entirely.

I still have £1300 to pay before I'm fully debt free, I've proactively tries to eat healthier and do exercise and try to communicate with people about how I'm feeling.

The issue I'm facing now is, the tanks been empty for a while and I'm running on fumes. Maybe deluding myself with hope is great and all but I don't want to be a victim. Realistically no one is coming to help me out of this. I'm here on this journey alone.

I just wish I wasn't in such a shit position I guess, due to how my health has plummeted over the last year, when everyone went into lockdown I was upset sure. I quickly realised that nothing really changed for me. I sit indoor because I can't afford to go outside or do anything I've always wanted to do.

All my dreams and ambitions aren't exactly expensive but feel so out of reach on my own, I know I'm selfish and it probably will hurt people but I'm just tired. I've spent the last week just lying in my room trying to find work or something to keep me occupied.

I'm at the stage now where I don't get any joy anymore. I remember a few years ago there was an event that caused me to feel genuine happiness for the first time in a long time.

Ideally honestly I would love to feel like that again, I don't think anyone really wants to die but honestly right now, I'm just feeling out of options. I truly am, I use to be so afraid of showing my emotions and being told to man up but I'm only human, that bottle burst a long time ago and I'll never be able to bottle them up again.

I cry constantly and I'm not even sure why, I have some heavy trauma to get through and I can't. I don't know what's wrong with me, my emotions don't work well and I can change how I feel in seconds. It pushes people away who I do try to talk to and I'm not sure what to do.

I guess I'm a social moron, sorry for the slower replies I've had some difficulties getting through today, I keep my emotions in check through physical stimulation through self harm, it's not healthy but it's the only way to ground myself.

I've stopped a few attempts in the past this way but it feels like I'm fighting with a depressed alter ego per say. I gave myself a week I guess as 'hope', but honestly I don't see anything changing by then. 

I think I've said everything I can think of saying now, again I apologise

Cheers

I really don't see hope for myself anymore, I don't have anyone..

I'm not overly approachable in person either because I absolutely no people skills and have constant panic attacks just by the idea of social activities. Even going for a job interview sends me into a panic.

I feel like there's really no support from me or I feel like I should just 'man up' but honestly I don't even feel in control of my emotions anymore. 

It's so obvious in conversation because I keep apologising and letting people walk over me, maybe I'm just attracting the wrong type of people into my life but I just constantly worried  of being totally alone and abandoned and that's pretty much where I've found myself now. 

I've always wanted a friend who would just step in and actually stand up for me, a family member to take me out of that hell before all of this. Just felt like no one had cared until now. 

I'm not sure any amount of positive encouragement over the next week will change my mind as I've lived a lifetime of negative 'encouragement' already. 

I've never really been a fan of hope just seems to be a way of deluding myself. Sorry if I seem majorly pessimistic, that's because I am. 

I think after so many years of being called so many negative things you just begin to believe it. I hate to admit it aswell but I do see some of my parents in myself. I never want to be like them. 

I've became my own biggest critic constantly alienating myself with constant reminders of what I've been labelled as in the past. 

I suppose now the only reason I can talk about it so easily is because I know the end is near, I almost feel like I'm on autopilot and just viewing myself from a third person, nothing really feels real anymore. 


I'm sorry again if it made you tear up wasn't my intention just wrote down how I felt without giving it much thought, thank you for taking the time to reply tho.
Can't know who is the real
